title: Almost 23,000 car seats are under recall. Here’s what you should know
text:
(Gray News) - Evenflo is recalling Revolve 180 Litemax NXT car seats manufactured until March 31, 2025, due to calibration issues.

The recall was announced on Aug. 6 and applies to just under 23,000 models.

According to the company, the level indicator may be miscalibrated in violation of a federal safety standard.

Letters notifying customers with the affected models are expected to go out starting Sept. 1.

Customers can call Evenflo for more information at 1-800-233-5921.
